title: A global synthesis of the effects of diversified farming systems on arthropod diversity and implications for pest control
publisher: Proceedings of the Royal Society B
methodology: Global synthesis of diversified farming effects on arthropod diversity.
limitations: Arthropod-focused; vertebrate responses may differ. Landscape context modifies on-farm diversification benefits.

chunks.text: Diversified farming systems generally support higher arthropod diversity than simplified monocultures. Habitat complexity at field and farm scales provides more ecological niches. The synthesis supports using non-crop vegetation and crop mixtures to improve biodiversity, while noting that pest-control outcomes depend on which taxa increase.
